label: late original-phase steps of f-initial sequences containing z (weak)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.003% of steps). Nearly all activation (98%) falls in the original phase at t>=4 (orig_idx 4-8, mostly the last 1-3 tokens before <DEL>); it never fires in the copy phase and only rarely on <DEL>. 75% of mass is in sequences whose first token is f (22x lift), and another 14% in sequences starting with z; a z earlier in the sequence is common. Inputs m, e, u, j, d, l are enriched (4-7x lift). Top examples look like f s z z z y t [u] or f q z m [m]. No predicate gets precision above a few percent: f-first & t>=4 covers 74% of mass at 0.4% precision; adding z-seen and the input-token set gives F1 0.11 on dev (precision 6.5%, recall 37%). Adjacent repeated tokens did not explain it. It probably picks out a narrow hidden-state configuration that these token-level variables do not capture. Magnitude is narrow (0.10-0.21); f-first sequences reach the highest values.
